posts.text: Personally supervising the NEET paper leak situation. We will not disappoint our youngsters. New mechanisms are being put in place for the re-test on June 21. Accountability must be fixed.

posts.text: Eid ul-Adha greetings! May this occasion deepen the spirit of brotherhood and happiness in our society. Praying for everyone's success and good health. — PM @narendramodi

posts.text: People, civil administration, police, military and BSF will make borders foolproof with a four-sided security grid. Now there will be complete territorial security and not just border security.

posts.text: A denial is not an answer. Why are the Education Minister and CBSE unable to answer the four simple questions I have asked? The future of 18.5 lakh students have been put in jeopardy. They deserve the truth.
posts.caption: A denial is not an answer. Why are the Education Minister and CBSE unable to answer the four simple questions I have asked? The future of 18.5 lakh students have been put in jeopardy. They deserve the truth.

posts.text: Technology, accountability and sensitivity must all be visible together in health services, only then will public trust become stronger. We are strengthening medical colleges and super-speciality services through modern technology across UP.
posts.caption: Technology, accountability and sensitivity must all be visible together in health services, only then will public trust become stronger. We are strengthening medical colleges and super-speciality services through modern technology across UP.

posts.text: Eid al-Adha Mubarak to all of you. May this Eid bring heaps of happiness and prosperity into your life and that of your family.
posts.caption: Eid al-Adha Mubarak to all of you. May this Eid bring heaps of happiness and prosperity into your life and that of your family.

posts.text: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive discussions on deepening India-EU ties and regional developments.
posts.caption: Interacted with FM Tsahkna of Estonia and European Commissioner for the Mediterranean Šuica at the Gymnich meeting in Cyprus. Productive discussions on deepening India-EU ties and regional developments.

posts.text: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue to drive employment and economic expansion. Budget 2026 balances discipline with ambition to keep India on a high-growth trajectory.
posts.caption: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue to drive employment and economic expansion. Budget 2026 balances discipline with ambition to keep India on a high-growth trajectory.

posts.text: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. Our commitment to building world-class ports, airports, and green energy assets remains unwavering. The nation's growth trajectory demands bold investments.
posts.caption: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. Our commitment to building world-class ports, airports, and green energy assets remains unwavering. The nation's growth trajectory demands bold investments.

posts.text: Drawing up specific plans for mega-investments in the power sector, including clean coal, solar, and nuclear power initiatives. India's energy future demands bold action and massive capacity expansion.
posts.caption: Drawing up specific plans for mega-investments in the power sector, including clean coal, solar, and nuclear power initiatives. India's energy future demands bold action and massive capacity expansion.

posts.text: Innovation and compassion must go hand in hand. India's entrepreneurial spirit continues to inspire — let us build a future where progress uplifts every citizen.
posts.caption: Innovation and compassion must go hand in hand. India's entrepreneurial spirit continues to inspire — let us build a future where progress uplifts every citizen.

posts.text: Heartiest greetings to all on the auspicious occasion of Eid ul-Adha. May this festival strengthen the bonds of harmony and brotherhood in our nation.
posts.caption: Heartiest greetings to all on the auspicious occasion of Eid ul-Adha. May this festival strengthen the bonds of harmony and brotherhood in our nation.

posts.text: Iran must agree that they will never have a Nuclear Weapon or Bomb. The Hormuz Strait must be immediately open, no tolls, for unrestricted shipping traffic. Ships caught in the Strait due to our amazing Naval Blockade may start heading home! Say HELLO to your families from me, your favorite President!
posts.caption: Iran must agree that they will never have a Nuclear Weapon or Bomb. The Hormuz Strait must be immediately open, no tolls, for unrestricted shipping traffic. posts.text: Proud to see the values of hard work and aspiration alive in communities across the UK. Our diaspora communities make Britain stronger every single day.
posts.caption: Proud to see the values of hard work and aspiration alive in communities across the UK. Our diaspora communities make Britain stronger every single day.

posts.text: Honored to have President Trump's total endorsement for Governor of Ohio. Time to bring AMERICA FIRST policies to the Buckeye State — cut regulations, grow the economy, and put citizens first.
posts.caption: Honored to have President Trump's total endorsement for Governor of Ohio. Time to bring AMERICA FIRST policies to the Buckeye State — cut regulations, grow the economy, and put citizens first.

posts.text: The strength of America lies in its communities. Grateful for the opportunities this country provides to those who work hard and dream big.
posts.caption: The strength of America lies in its communities. Grateful for the opportunities this country provides to those who work hard and dream big.

posts.text: Accountability and transparency in government — that's what the American people deserve. We're delivering results, not just promises.
posts.caption: Accountability and transparency in government — that's what the American people deserve. We're delivering results, not just promises.

posts.text: The pace of AI innovation is breathtaking. Building the future of technology policy at the intersection of American ambition and global talent.
posts.caption: The pace of AI innovation is breathtaking. Building the future of technology policy at the intersection of American ambition and global talent.

posts.text: The World Bank is committed to accelerating development outcomes. Climate resilience, digital infrastructure, and inclusive growth are not just goals — they are imperatives.
posts.caption: The World Bank is committed to accelerating development outcomes. Climate resilience, digital infrastructure, and inclusive growth are not just goals — they are imperatives.

posts.text: The challenges Europe now faces demands an even stronger partnership. This treaty with Poland is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship in a generation, allowing us to confront modern threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.
posts.caption: The challenges Europe now faces demands an even stronger partnership. This treaty with Poland is the biggest step forward in our defence and security relationship in a generation, allowing us to confront modern threats that may be less visible but no less dangerous.

posts.text: Australia's relationship with India continues to deepen — in trade, defence, and people-to-people ties. Together we're building a stronger Indo-Pacific.
posts.caption: Australia's relationship with India continues to deepen — in trade, defence, and people-to-people ties. Together we're building a stronger Indo-Pacific.

posts.text: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran conflict. Europe must take responsibility for its own security and global stability.
posts.caption: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting on keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran conflict. Europe must take responsibility for its own security and global stability.

posts.text: The UAE's vision is clear: build bridges, not walls. Our nation thrives on innovation, tolerance, and the ambition to create opportunities for the next generation.
posts.caption: The UAE's vision is clear: build bridges, not walls. Our nation thrives on innovation, tolerance, and the ambition to create opportunities for the next generation.

posts.text: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.
posts.caption: SpaceX has not committed to leasing Colossus for years, although it's possible that may be what happens. The short term was our request, not Anthropic's. We won't leave them hanging and will provide a reasonable off-ramp, but if compute gets super tight I said we might need it back at some point.

posts.text: AI glasses are the next major computing platform. We're deepening our investment in EssilorLuxottica and building the future of how people interact with information in the real world.
posts.caption: AI glasses are the next major computing platform. We're deepening our investment in EssilorLuxottica and building the future of how people interact with information in the real world.

posts.text: AI is helping us solve some of the most complex challenges in science and medicine. At Google, we're making these tools accessible to developers and researchers everywhere.
posts.caption: AI is helping us solve some of the most complex challenges in science and medicine. At Google, we're making these tools accessible to developers and researchers everywhere.

posts.text: We're seeing real acceleration of AI applications in science — generating new molecules, new materials. Microsoft is committed to making AI a platform for every developer and every organization.
posts.caption: We're seeing real acceleration of AI applications in science — generating new molecules, new materials. Microsoft is committed to making AI a platform for every developer and every organization.

posts.text: OpenAI reached a new agreement with the Pentagon allowing deployment of our models in classified networks. We're asking the DoD to offer these same terms to all AI companies — we think everyone should be willing to accept them.
posts.caption: OpenAI reached a new agreement with the Pentagon allowing deployment of our models in classified networks. We're asking the DoD to offer these same terms to all AI companies — we think everyone should be willing to accept them.

posts.text: Continuing to deepen Apple's engagement with global academic institutions. Innovation happens when technology meets education — excited about the collaborations ahead.
posts.caption: Continuing to deepen Apple's engagement with global academic institutions. Innovation happens when technology meets education — excited about the collaborations ahead.

posts.text: Honored to join the advisory board of Tsinghua University's School of Economics and Management. AI has no borders — collaboration between the world's best institutions drives progress for everyone.
posts.caption: Honored to join the advisory board of Tsinghua University's School of Economics and Management. AI has no borders — collaboration between the world's best institutions drives progress for everyone.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC — the platform approach is transforming financial inclusion and commerce at population scale.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world. From UPI to Aadhaar to ONDC — the platform approach is transforming financial inclusion and commerce at population scale.

posts.text: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. The breakthroughs happening in healthcare and education will help billions of people. We need to make sure the benefits reach everyone.
posts.caption: AI is going to be the most transformative technology of our lifetimes. The breakthroughs happening in healthcare and education will help billions of people. We need to make sure the benefits reach everyone.

posts.text: Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating. At IBM, we're helping clients move from AI experiments to real business value — that's where the transformation happens.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI adoption is accelerating. At IBM, we're helping clients move from AI experiments to real business value — that's where the transformation happens.

posts.text: Creativity powered by AI is unlocking new possibilities for every creator and enterprise. Adobe is building the tools that make this transformation accessible to all.
posts.caption: Creativity powered by AI is unlocking new possibilities for every creator and enterprise. Adobe is building the tools that make this transformation accessible to all.

posts.text: Building in AI requires balancing ambition with responsibility. The next generation of products will be defined by how thoughtfully we deploy these capabilities.
posts.caption: Building in AI requires balancing ambition with responsibility. The next generation of products will be defined by how thoughtfully we deploy these capabilities.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity enhanced by technology — not replaced by it. The future of luxury is personal, sustainable, and deeply human.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity enhanced by technology — not replaced by it. The future of luxury is personal, sustainable, and deeply human.

posts.text: Global trade is being reshaped. At FedEx, we're leveraging AI and data to make supply chains smarter, faster, and more resilient for businesses everywhere.
posts.caption: Global trade is being reshaped. At FedEx, we're leveraging AI and data to make supply chains smarter, faster, and more resilient for businesses everywhere.

posts.text: 9,261 IPL runs — more than my entire Test career. This game keeps giving. Onwards to the final! 🏐💪
posts.caption: 9,261 IPL runs — more than my entire Test career. This game keeps giving. Onwards to the final! 🏐💪
